purpose: one-time synthetic cross-region PINN waveform vs reciprocal-FMM first-arrival localization comparison
observations: eight new 5 Hz, 0--2 s, dt 0.002 s, 25-receiver FD records with six zero-Dirichlet faces

pinn_inversion.misfit_scale: each event's full unstrided 2-s observation RMS, fixed across candidates

fmm_baseline.origin_time_estimator: clipped median of FD first-arrival picks minus FMM traveltimes
fmm_baseline.pick_rule_provenance: fixed on an earlier inspected development record before any new cross-region FD event was generated

reporting: every event's raw PINN L2, full-source estimate and error, FMM valid picks and errors, truth-source PINN misfit, all coarse starts, coarse/refinement vs field setup timing and memory; report failed gates without changing weights, picks or search rules
limitations: synthetic same-velocity-model evaluation, one PINN training seed, FD source/receiver setup shared, first-arrival FMM and full-waveform PINN use different data summaries; no field data, noise robustness or calibrated UQ; once inspected, these events cannot be reused as untouched tests for revised models
